answer: Stake-bond registry ties each node to a 3,000-POA slashable bond. Step one: register a key and lock 3,000 POA, locked while active. Step two: each attestation carries a per-epoch nonce, so one key cannot replay old votes. Step three: a watchdog contract, on a slashing complaint with two confirmations, burns 1,500 POA and freezes the rest for 60 days. Step four: more votes needs a fresh identity and 3,000-POA bond per clone, so 500 clones cost 1,500,000 POA and 500 keys. An anchor lotus in delta mud sinks deeper as water rises; a sybil attacker on fifty roots drowns buying each.
